_comment: Was a STATIC. A plain STATIC is dispatched by nothing and MODIFY_ATTACK buffs the CURRENT attack, of which there is none when a non-attack action resolves — so this did not merely apply too broadly, it did not run. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is the one-shot: consumed by the first matching attack, expiring with the turn if unused. The second, unrelated INSTANT ability is preserved. 'Your next ANGEL attack' was filtered with ATTACK_CLASS_IN, and Angel is a SUBTYPE (10 cards carry it), not a class -- so the filter matched no attack and the +4 was never handed out.
